commentary_segments.text_raw:
Up till now, only amplifiers
have been discussed. There
are two more functions that
can be carried out by means
of a single-transistor. They
are a source-follower and a
cascode.
Of course we can still use
a transistor as a switch, as
we will do in Chapter 14 on
Switched-capacitor filters.
